description_zh: 用于将源数据源的SQL语句转换为目标数据源对应的SQL语句
name: PostInnerConvert

parameters.help_en: SQL node type mapping, where the key is the source node type and the value is the target node type. If not empty, it will be assembled into `workflow.converter.sqlNodeTypeMapping` in `innerConvertConfig` and written via the task configuration update interface after creating the scheduling transformation task
parameters.help_zh: SQL 节点类型映射，键为源节点类型，值为目标节点类型。非空时将被组装为 innerConvertConfig 中的 workflow.converter.sqlNodeTypeMapping，在创建调度转换任务后调用任务配置更新接口写入
parameters.name: sql_convert_map

parameters.help_en: Source data source name, i.e., the name of the scheduling data source at the source end of the transformation task
parameters.help_zh: 源数据源名称，即转换任务源端调度数据源的名称
parameters.name: src_data_source_name

parameters.help_en: Target data source name, i.e., the name of the scheduling data source at the target end of the transformation task
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据源名称，即转换任务目标端调度数据源的名称
parameters.name: tgt_data_source_name

data.description_en: Business data, the identifier of the transformation task returned upon successful submission of this interface
data.description_zh: 业务数据，本接口提交成功后返回的转换任务标识

errCode.description_en: Error code, which is an empty string when the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: Error message, which is an empty string when the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: Request ID, used for locating and troubleshooting issues with this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful: `true` indicates success, `false` indicates failure. In case of failure, troubleshoot using `errCode` and `errMessage`
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
